options.label: Scan for treasure
options.tooltip: Periodically scans the current area and reports whether unopened treasure containers remain. Disabled by default.

options.label: Track found treasure
options.tooltip: Tracks discovered containers after they are examined so treasure notifications reflect what remains unlooted.

options.label: Automatically loot treasure
options.tooltip: Automatically transfers eligible items and gold from examined treasure containers to the player.

options.label: Identify loot using party Lore
options.tooltip: Before auto-looting an unidentified item, lets the player or a nearby party member identify it when their current Lore skill is sufficient. Enabled by default.

options.label: Make corpses lootable
options.tooltip: Keeps defeated creatures available as containers so their inventory can be examined and looted.

options.label: Remove looted corpses
options.tooltip: Allows a corpse to disappear after all physical items and gold have been removed from it.

options.label: Remove corpses over time
options.tooltip: Schedules lootable corpses for removal after the configured corpse decay time.

options.label: Allow Raise Dead on corpses
options.tooltip: Keeps lootable corpses valid targets for resurrection effects while they remain in the area.

options.label: Loot examined corpses
options.tooltip: Automatically transfers eligible contents after the player examines and closes a corpse inventory.

options.label: Loot creatures killed by player
options.tooltip: Automatically transfers eligible loot when the player character deals the killing blow.

options.label: Loot creatures killed by companions
options.tooltip: Automatically transfers eligible loot when a companion or another party-controlled creature deals the killing blow.

options.label: Show item acquisition details
options.tooltip: Adds the previous owner and area of acquisition to the descriptions of items looted by MELSE.

options.label: Arrows
options.tooltip: Always picks up arrows, ignoring the configured item price and weight filters.
options.heading: Pick up all:

options.label: Bolts
options.tooltip: Always picks up bolts, ignoring the configured item price and weight filters.

options.label: Bullets
options.tooltip: Always picks up sling bullets, ignoring the configured item price and weight filters.

options.label: Books
options.tooltip: Always picks up books, notes, and journals, ignoring the configured item price and weight filters.

options.label: Corpse decay time (seconds)
options.tooltip: Sets how many seconds a timed lootable corpse remains before it can be removed.

options.label: Minimum item value
options.tooltip: Leaves identified non-plot items below this base value behind. Zero disables the price filter; keys and quest items are always kept, while ammunition is filtered normally.

options.label: Maximum item weight
options.tooltip: Leaves identified non-plot items heavier than this base weight behind. Zero disables the weight filter.
